en.title: How to Book Forbidden City Tickets as a Foreigner (2026)
en.headline: Forbidden City for Foreign Visitors: Tickets and Entry
en.description: No same-day tickets: they usually release 7 days ahead at 8 p.m. Beijing time. Book with your passport on the official English site; Tiananmen Square access explained.

zh.title: 外国人预约天安门城楼和故宫：护照实名、放票时间、约满怎么办
zh.headline: 外国人怎么预约天安门城楼、天安门广场和故宫
zh.description: 外国护照可以实名预约天安门广场、天安门城楼和故宫，但要分开约。故宫不售当日票，通常参观前 7 天北京时间 20:00 放票；约满或填错怎么补救，一篇说清。
